title: Manager Asset Specialist- Visakhapatnam (Vizag)
description:
**Job Location\-Visakhapatnam (Vizag)**

 **Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **Business Description**

  

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra\-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the IWPB team.

 **Principal Responsibilities**

  

The incumbent will be responsible for facilitation of the asset sales process including customer interface, document completion, interaction on behalf of RMs with builders/societies in case of mortgage cases, discrepancy resolution etc.

  

* Would be responsible for Asset Product Disbursal of the region
* Facilitate business – new as well as existing cases – with the branch asset specialists.
* Develop an expert knowledge of customer base, market trends, and competitor activities to manage strategic direction.
* Engage with builders, brokers and other intermediaries to develop business for the region.
* Daily co\-ordination with internal stakeholders such as underwriting, Legal, etc. for pre \& post approval activities.
* Provide dedicated back\-end support to Branch RMs in the login, approval and disbursal of their applications.
* Interact with senior business managers to identify peer company best\-in\-class service practices \& technologies
* Operational effectiveness: Ensure that discrepancy rates of pre \& post approval applications are within acceptable benchmarks
* Ensure NIL fraudulent application.

 **Qualifications \- External**

  

* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4\-7 years of relevant experience

 **Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.**

  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

 *Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

description:
**IT Project Coordinator(West Bengal Candidates apply only)**

**Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month  
**Experience:** 2–3 years  
**Qualification:** B.Tech preferred  
**Preferred Academic Background:** Mathematics / Physics / Engineering  
**Immediate Joiners:** Preferred

Job Overview

Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **IT Project Coordinator** with **2–3 years of hands\-on experience in IT project coordination and project handling**. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating project activities, tracking timelines, communicating with technical teams and stakeholders, and ensuring projects are delivered smoothly and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and monitor **end\-to\-end IT project activities**.
* Work closely with developers, QA teams, UI/UX teams and other technical departments.
* Track project **scope, timelines, milestones and deliverables**.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules and status reports.
* Coordinate daily/weekly project meetings and follow up on action items.
* Communicate project updates, issues and dependencies to management.
* Identify project risks, delays and dependencies and escalate them when required.
* Ensure tasks are assigned to the appropriate team members and followed up regularly.
* Coordinate with clients/stakeholders regarding project requirements and progress.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting minutes and project trackers.
* Follow up with technical teams to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Support requirement gathering and ensure proper communication between business and technical teams.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to management.
* Assist in resolving project\-related issues and coordination gaps.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and requirements.

Required Skills

* 2–3 years of experience in **IT Project Coordination / Project Management / Project Handling**.
* Hands\-on experience coordinating **software/IT projects**.
* Good understanding of the **software development lifecycle (SDLC)**.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel, MS Office and project tracking tools**.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up, documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical teams.
* Good problem\-solving and organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Educational Qualification:\-

* **B.Tech / B.E. preferred.**
* Candidates with an academic background in **Mathematics, Physics or Engineering** will be preferred.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
We are looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter with strong expertise in W2 hiring and Tier 1 staffing. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience sourcing and recruiting IT professionals for contract, contract\-to\-hire, and full\-time positions.
 



 The candidate must be comfortable working with job boards such as Dice and Monster, as well as Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as JobDiva, Ceipal, or similar platforms.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Source, identify, and recruit qualified IT professionals for various technical positions.
* Handle W2 and Tier 1 requirements from sourcing through candidate submission and onboarding.
* Utilize Dice, Monster, LinkedIn, and other job portals for candidate sourcing.
* Work extensively with ATS platforms such as JobDiva, Ceipal, or similar systems.
* Review resumes, conduct initial screening, and assess candidates against job requirements.
* Conduct technical and behavioral screening calls to evaluate candidate qualifications.
* Maintain and update accurate candidate records, notes, statuses, and submissions in the ATS.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers/clients.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment and onboarding process.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified technical candidates.
* Work closely with Account Managers, Recruiters, and Hiring Managers to understand requirements and priorities.
* Meet daily/weekly sourcing, submission, interview, and hiring targets.
* Ensure candidates meet employment eligibility and client\-specific requirements.
* Maintain professional communication with candidates and provide timely updates throughout the hiring process.


 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 * 2\+ years of experience as a Technical Recruiter / IT Recruiter.
* Hands\-on experience with W2 recruiting and Tier 1 staffing.
* Strong experience recruiting for IT/technical positions.
* Hands\-on experience with Dice, Monster, and other job boards.
* Experience using JobDiva, Ceipal, or another ATS.
* Strong knowledge of US IT staffing and recruitment processes.
* Experience with contract, contract\-to\-hire, and direct\-hire recruiting.
* Excellent candidate sourcing and screening skills.
* Strong understanding of technical skill sets, job descriptions, and IT technologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven recruiting environment.
* Strong follow\-up, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills.


 Preferred Experience
 * Experience recruiting candidates for Tier 1 vendors/MSP clients.
* Experience working with implementation partners and direct clients.
* Familiarity with VMS/MSP recruitment processes.
* Experience working on multiple technical requirements simultaneously.
* Existing candidate database/network within the US IT staffing market.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Qualified candidate submissions
* Interview\-to\-submission ratio
* Placements and closures
* Candidate pipeline generation
* Time\-to\-submit
* Daily sourcing activity
* Candidate follow\-up and database management

title: Site Operations Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**About the Role**

  

The Site Operations Lead is responsible for building and leading the Operations function for Haleon's new greenfield manufacturing facility in Indore. The role will provide operational leadership during design, commissioning, qualification, start\-up and early stabilization, and subsequently lead manufacturing operations to deliver safety, quality, service level, cost and people engagement objectives.  



  

The role will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HAPS, EHS and Project teams to establish operational systems, build workforce capability and ensure successful commissioning and ramp\-up of the manufacturing site.


The incumbent will drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, capability development, performance management and continuous improvement while creating a safe, compliant and high\-performing manufacturing culture.


Build a future\-ready Operations organization that delivers safe start\-up, reliable supply, competitive performance and sustainable growth.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own and deliver site performance across Safety, Quality, GMP Compliance, Cost, Service, Productivity, and People Development.
* This role joins the project at an early stage to ensure operational requirements are incorporated into the facility execution. It leads operations and technical teams through a vertical startup. Then owns performance of the people and system once the site is operational.
* Lead manufacturing and packaging operations, ensuring achievement of production, OEE, cost, waste, and service targets (ATS adherence to schedule and ATP adherence to planning).
* Drive a strong safety\-first and quality culture, ensuring compliance with EHS, GMP, regulatory, and data integrity requirements.
* Build, coach, and develop high\-performing teams through capability building, succession planning, and performance management.
* Accountable for manufacturing budgets, MCC / PCC conversion costs, labor productivity, and delivery of productivity commitments.
* Lead operational readiness, commissioning, qualification, validation, start\-up, and stabilization of manufacturing operations.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and technical teams to ensure reliable product supply and operational excellence.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks while ensuring sustainable business performance Complexity/Scope
* Integrate Haleon Operational Excellence strategies from inception by working closely with Site Director.
* Integrate industry 4\.0 capabilities
* Establish effective daily management systems (HAPS), performance reviews, visual management, and KPI governance.
Champion continuous improvement, loss elimination, problem\-solving, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives  
* 

  

**Qualification and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Science, Manufacturing, Operations or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM is desirable
* Overall 15\+ years of industrial experience in manufacturing sector.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food or another regulated manufacturing sector.
* Demonstrated experience leading Manufacturing and Packaging operations, production performance, workforce capability and cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience supporting a greenfield facility, major expansion, commissioning, qualification, validation, technology transfer or manufacturing start\-up is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of GMP, EHS, operational risk management, production planning, OEE, cost control and continuous improvement systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make risk\-based decisions and translate project milestones into operational readiness and sustainable performance.
Relevant certification or practical experience in Lean, Six Sigma, TPM or another recognized operational\-excellence system is desirable.  
* 

  

**Soft Skills**

* Strong people leadership capability to build, engage and hold a large frontline organization accountable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence Project, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain and senior leaders.
* Hands\-on, collaborative and decisive leadership style with strong execution and change\-management capability.
* Excellent oral, written and presentation skills, with clear communication from shop\-floor teams to senior leadership.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, risk\-based decision\-making and commercial awareness.
* High resilience, ownership and ability to deliver in a fast\-paced greenfield and start\-up environment.
Proficiency in MS Office and working knowledge of SAP, Power BI, OEE, problem solving and digital manufacturing performance systems.  
* 

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety, Quality \& Compliance – Waste/ Scrap%, CAPA Closure Effectiveness, Deviation Reduction, GMP / EHS Compliance Adherence, Safety Observation Closure %, Zero LTI.
* Operational Readiness \& Performance \- Commissioning and start\-up milestones, schedule adherence (ATS), OEE, throughput, right\-first time (RFT), Cost (PCC, MCC), Waste, Customer Service Level (% OTIF) and productivity.
* People \& Organization \- Workforce readiness, drive shop floor associate ownership, role qualification, engagement, leadership capability, succession strength and a sustainable ownership culture.
Unplanned Downtime (hrs./month),Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), AM / PM and maturity assessment and Haleon Operational Excellence pillar drive and maturity assessment.  
* 

**Job Posting End Date**

2026\-10\-22  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.
